name: Software Developer
summary: Designs, writes and tests the software behind apps, websites and business systems.
day: Write code, fix bugs, review teammates' code, plan features in short sprints.
education: B.Tech / BE in CS or IT, or BCA + MCA
roadmap: Learn one language well (Python or Java)
Build 3-4 projects and put them on GitHub
Prepare for coding interviews and apply

name: Data Scientist
summary: Finds patterns in data and builds models that help companies make decisions.
day: Clean data, build and test models, make charts, explain results to managers.
education: B.Tech / B.Sc in CS, Maths or Statistics; M.Sc / M.Tech in Data Science helps
roadmap: Get strong in statistics and Python

name: AI / ML Engineer
summary: Builds and deploys artificial intelligence systems such as chatbots, vision and prediction models.
day: Train models, tune them, put them into apps, monitor how they perform.
education: B.Tech in CS / AI and Data Science; M.Tech helps for research roles
roadmap: Master Python, linear algebra and probability

name: Cyber Security Analyst
summary: Protects organisations from hackers by monitoring systems and responding to attacks.
day: Watch security alerts, investigate incidents, test systems for weaknesses, write reports.
education: B.Tech / BCA in CS; M.Tech in Cyber Security helps

name: Cloud / DevOps Engineer
summary: Runs the servers and automation that keep websites and apps online and fast.
day: Set up cloud servers, automate deployments, fix outages, reduce costs.
education: B.Tech / BCA in CS or IT

name: UI / UX Designer
summary: Designs how apps and websites look and feel so they are easy and pleasant to use.
day: Talk to users, sketch screens, build prototypes in Figma, test with real people.
education: B.Des / B.Tech / any degree with a strong portfolio
roadmap: Learn design basics: colour, type, layout
Redesign 3 real apps for your portfolio

name: Civil Engineer
summary: Plans and builds roads, bridges, buildings, dams and water systems.
day: Visit sites, check designs and drawings, manage workers, control cost and safety.
education: B.Tech / BE in Civil Engineering
roadmap: Prepare for GATE or state engineering exams

name: Mechanical Engineer
summary: Designs and improves machines, engines, vehicles and manufacturing systems.
day: Design parts in CAD, test prototypes, run production lines, solve machine problems.
education: B.Tech / BE in Mechanical Engineering
roadmap: Pick a field: automobile, energy or manufacturing
Prepare for GATE or PSU jobs

name: Electrical Engineer
summary: Works on power generation, electric vehicles, motors and the electricity grid.
day: Design and test circuits and power systems, maintain equipment, ensure safety.
education: B.Tech / BE in Electrical Engineering
roadmap: Intern at a power or EV company

name: Electronics / VLSI Engineer
summary: Designs chips, circuits and embedded systems used in phones, cars and gadgets.
day: Design and simulate circuits, write firmware, test boards in the lab.
education: B.Tech / BE in Electronics and Communication; M.Tech for VLSI
roadmap: Do an M.Tech or VLSI course

name: Doctor (MBBS)
summary: Diagnoses and treats illness, and can specialise as a surgeon, paediatrician and more.
day: See patients, examine and order tests, prescribe treatment, do night duties.
education: MBBS (5.5 years) then MD / MS for specialisation
roadmap: Score well in PCB in Class 12
Choose a specialisation via NEET PG

name: Nurse
summary: Cares for patients, gives medicines and supports doctors in hospitals and clinics.
day: Monitor patients, give medicines and injections, keep records, comfort families.
education: B.Sc Nursing or GNM

name: Pharmacist
summary: Prepares and dispenses medicines and advises on safe use; can work in pharma companies.
day: Check prescriptions, dispense medicines, advise patients, or work on drug production and quality.
education: B.Pharm (4 years) or D.Pharm; M.Pharm for research

name: Physiotherapist
summary: Helps people recover movement after injury, surgery or illness through exercise and therapy.
day: Assess patients, plan exercise programmes, give hands-on therapy, track recovery.
education: BPT (4.5 years); MPT to specialise
roadmap: Work in a hospital, sports team or own clinic

name: Psychologist / Counsellor
summary: Helps people with stress, emotions and behaviour through counselling and therapy.
day: Listen to clients, assess problems, run therapy sessions, keep confidential notes.
education: BA / B.Sc Psychology, MA Psychology; M.Phil for clinical practice
roadmap: Choose clinical, school or organisational psychology

name: Dentist (BDS)
summary: Treats teeth and gum problems and can specialise in braces, surgery or implants.
day: Examine teeth, do fillings, cleanings and root canals, advise on oral health.
education: BDS (5 years); MDS to specialise
roadmap: Join a clinic or start your own

name: Chartered Accountant (CA)
summary: Handles audits, taxes and financial reports for companies and individuals.
day: Audit accounts, file taxes, advise companies on money and law.
education: CA course from ICAI (Foundation, Intermediate, Final + articleship)
roadmap: Take Commerce with Maths if possible
Clear Intermediate and do 2-3 years of articleship

name: Financial Analyst / Investment Banker
summary: Studies companies and markets to advise on investments, mergers and funding.
day: Build financial models in Excel, study company reports, write investment notes.
education: B.Com / BBA / B.Tech, then MBA (Finance) or CFA
roadmap: Do CFA Level 1 or an MBA in Finance
Intern at a bank or broker

name: Company Secretary (CS)
summary: Makes sure a company follows company law and manages board meetings and legal filings.
day: Prepare legal filings, organise board meetings, advise directors on rules.
education: CS course from ICSI (Executive and Professional)

name: Bank Officer (PO)
summary: Manages customers, loans and branch work in public sector or private banks.
day: Handle customer accounts, approve loans, manage branch staff and targets.
education: Any graduation
roadmap: Follow banking awareness and current affairs

name: Digital Marketer
summary: Grows brands online using social media, search engines, ads and content.
day: Plan campaigns, write posts and ads, study analytics, improve results week by week.
education: BBA / B.Com / BMM or any degree with certifications
roadmap: Learn SEO, social media and ads basics
Grow a page or blog as practice

name: Entrepreneur / Startup Founder
summary: Starts and runs a new business, from an idea to a working company.
day: Talk to customers, build the product, hire people, manage money, raise funds.
education: Any degree; BBA / MBA or a technical degree help
roadmap: Find a real problem people pay to solve

name: HR Manager
summary: Hires people, manages employee welfare, salaries and company culture.
day: Interview candidates, solve employee issues, plan training, handle payroll policies.
education: BBA / any degree, then MBA (HR)

name: Business Analyst
summary: Connects business teams and tech teams by turning needs and data into clear requirements.
day: Meet stakeholders, analyse data in Excel / SQL, write requirement documents, track projects.
education: BBA / B.Com / B.Tech; MBA helps
roadmap: Learn Excel, SQL and Power BI

name: Journalist / News Reporter
summary: Finds, checks and reports news for newspapers, TV and digital media.
day: Chase stories, interview people, verify facts, write or present reports to deadline.
education: BA Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC) or any degree + diploma
roadmap: Do BJMC or a journalism diploma
Intern at a newspaper or channel
Build a portfolio of published stories

name: Graphic Designer
summary: Creates logos, posters, social media posts and brand visuals.
day: Read the brief, sketch ideas, design in Photoshop / Illustrator / Canva, revise with clients.
education: B.Des / BFA / diploma in graphic design

name: Fashion Designer
summary: Designs clothes and accessories and follows them from sketch to store.
day: Research trends, sketch collections, choose fabrics, work with tailors and brands.
education: B.Des Fashion (NIFT, NID, private colleges)
roadmap: Intern with a designer or brand
Launch a collection or join a label

name: Content Writer / Author
summary: Writes blogs, website text, scripts, books and social media content.
day: Research a topic, write and edit articles or scripts, meet deadlines, optimise for SEO.
education: BA English / Journalism or any degree

name: Film / Video Editor and Creator
summary: Edits films, YouTube videos, reels and ads, or creates video content.
day: Cut footage, add sound and effects, colour-correct, publish and study analytics.
education: Diploma / degree in film, animation or mass media, or self-taught
roadmap: Freelance, join a studio or grow a channel

name: Architect
summary: Designs buildings and spaces that are safe, useful and beautiful.
day: Meet clients, sketch and model designs, prepare drawings, visit construction sites.
education: B.Arch (5 years)
roadmap: Register with the Council of Architecture

name: Civil Services (IAS / IPS)
summary: Runs districts, police and government departments and puts public policy into action.
day: Manage a district or department, solve public problems, handle law and order and welfare schemes.
education: Any graduation
roadmap: Read newspapers and NCERT books daily
Prepare for UPSC Prelims, Mains and Interview
Be patient: it often takes 2-3 attempts

name: Lawyer
summary: Advises clients and argues cases in court on criminal, corporate, family and other law.
day: Read case files, research law, draft documents, argue in court, advise clients.
education: 5-year integrated LLB (BA LLB / BBA LLB) or 3-year LLB after graduation
roadmap: Clear the All India Bar Exam
Choose litigation, corporate law or judiciary

name: Defence Officer (Army / Navy / Air Force)
summary: Leads soldiers, sailors or airmen and protects the country.
day: Train daily, lead a unit, plan operations, serve in different parts of India.
education: NDA after Class 12, or CDS / AFCAT after graduation
roadmap: Take PCM for Navy / Air Force (NDA)

name: Police / SSC Government Officer
summary: Works in central or state government departments, tax, police or ministries through SSC and state exams.
day: Handle office or field duties, enforce rules, manage records and public services.
education: Any graduation (some posts after Class 12)
roadmap: Prepare quant, reasoning, English and GK

name: Teacher / Professor
summary: Teaches students in schools, colleges or online, and can do research as a professor.
day: Plan lessons, teach classes, check work, guide students, do research (college).
education: B.Ed for school; Master's + NET / PhD for college
roadmap: Graduate in the subject you love

name: Research Scientist
summary: Does experiments and studies to discover new knowledge in labs like ISRO, DRDO and universities.
day: Plan experiments, collect and analyse data, read papers, write and publish results.
education: B.Sc / BS-MS, M.Sc, then PhD
roadmap: Take Science and love one subject
Do an M.Sc and research internships
Clear NET / GATE for a PhD

name: Biotechnologist
summary: Uses living cells and biology to make medicines, vaccines, crops and green products.
day: Run lab experiments, culture cells, test samples, record and analyse data.
education: B.Tech / B.Sc Biotechnology; M.Sc / PhD for research
roadmap: Join pharma, vaccine or agri-biotech firms

name: Environmental Scientist
summary: Studies pollution, climate and nature and helps protect the environment.
day: Collect field samples, test air and water, write impact reports, advise on policy.
education: B.Sc / M.Sc Environmental Science
roadmap: Join NGOs, consultancies or pollution boards

name: Hotel Management / Chef
summary: Runs hotels, restaurants and kitchens, or cooks as a professional chef.
day: Manage guests and staff, plan menus, cook, control quality and cost.
education: BHM / B.Sc Hospitality
roadmap: Do industrial training in a hotel
Choose kitchen, front office or management
Grow in hotels, cruise ships or open a restaurant

name: Commercial Pilot
summary: Flies passenger and cargo aircraft for airlines.
day: Plan flights, check the aircraft, fly safely, talk with air traffic control.
education: Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL) from a DGCA-approved flying school
roadmap: Clear the DGCA Class 2 and Class 1 medical
Get a type rating and join an airline
